Hello, Mattsun! I'm back to make another request. I know it's a bit late for Golden Week, but I'd like to request a drawing of my cyberpunk TTRPG character Natsu in a gold bikini. She is wearing a pair of dark sunglasses on her head to reveal her golden eyes and is holding an alcoholic drink in one hand. I'd like her to be sitting on the edge of a pool with her legs in the water, and giving the viewer a seductive look. Finally, I'd like her bikini top to be a bit small for her, so it squishes her boobs together a bit.

Here are some references for my idea: https://imgchest.com/p/m9yxr5xwpyq
